question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is '**touching**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The passage recounts the emotional reunion of Sudama and Krishna after many years. 
 
• The appropriate adjective should convey a strong emotional impact. 
 
• "**Touching**" fits well as it describes something that evokes feelings of tenderness and affection. 
 
• Other options ("**collective**", "**tormenting**", "**gruelling**") do not capture the intended emotional impact. 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: * The two, Sudama and Krishna, were (1) **inseparable**__. To date, their oneness is an example of true friendship ahead of the planet. This is often the rationale why they are remembered (2) __**on**__ the auspicious day of Friendship. Even after losing touch for several years after finishing their studies together, they did not (3) __**leave**__ the hope of meeting again. Sudama always had lord Krishna in his heart and soul and kept (4) __**thinking**__ of him until they met again. The entire incident when Sudama met Krishna after numerous years is so (5) __**touching**__ and unforgettable. * 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** __Additional Information__ ** 

 
• Collective (सामूहिक): "Collective" means done by people acting as a group, which does not fit the personal and emotional nature of the incident. 
 
• Tormenting (यातनापूर्ण): "Tormenting" means causing severe physical or mental suffering, which does not fit the positive emotions described. 
 
• Gruelling (कठिन): "Gruelling" means extremely tiring and demanding, which does not align with the context of the emotional reunion.
